newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 2.7 pct vs year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 2.7 pct vs year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 58,587 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended Oct 26, up 2.7 percent from the same period last year, said Edison Electric Institute Wednesday.
The Pacific Northwest showed the greatest percentage gain last week, up 4.7 percent from the corresponding period in 1995 to 3,371 GWh, EEI said.
Total power output in the contiguous 48 states was down 0.5 percent from the previous reporting week.
Year-to-date domestic power production totaled about 2.74 million GWh, up 2.2 percent from the same period in 1995, EEI said.
